chunks: Surely your Lord is the Creator and knows (everything).
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for God to be Al-Khallaq and Al-'Alim?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Hijr, this verse reassures the Prophet Muhammad of God's absolute sovereignty amidst the disbelievers' doubts, highlighting that the Creator is also the All-Knowing of every hidden and apparent detail. Shia exegesis often links this pairing to the concept of divine omniscience extending to the Imams, who possess knowledge derived from the Creator's infinite wisdom. This duality serves as a theological anchor for both the reality of creation and the continuity of divine guidance.
